meta.title: Pricing · {brand}
meta.description: Free for individual researchers and students, a banded subscription for startups, custom for enterprise. No final prices yet.

hero.heading: Free for researchers. Fair for startups.
hero.lede: No prices are final and nothing on this page is an offer. We set prices after discovery interviews with the teams who would pay them.

sections.heading: Three tiers, one platform.
body: Every tier runs on the same provenance graph. Higher tiers add hosting, governance and the controls regulated teams need.

items.heading: Academic: free for individuals
items.body: For individual researchers and students, with fair-use limits. The Python SDK (licence pending), local provenance, and BIDS, NWB and LSL integrations. Labs and core facilities are planned for a separate paid plan; pricing at launch.

items.heading: Startup: banded subscription
items.body: For seed-stage neurotech teams. Hosted pipelines, the consent and deletion ledger for core US states, and SSO. A subscription priced in bands of data subjects and devices; pricing at launch.

items.heading: Enterprise: custom
items.body: For organizations with regulated data. BAA available for enterprise (planned), SSO and advanced RBAC, and single-tenant or on-prem deployment on the roadmap.

sections.heading: Why there are no prices yet.
body: We would rather publish a price we have tested than one we guessed. Early-access members will see pricing first and can help shape it.

sections.heading: Join the early-access list.
body: The early-access list opens soon. We are not collecting any email addresses until our privacy policy is published.
